verdict.rationale: llamafile's core pitch is a single self-contained executable that runs immediately with no installation, container setup, or separate runtime install (llamafile-docs-3, llamafile-docs-16, llamafile-docs-19, llamafile-gh-3), and a community report confirms it 'worked easily... first try' with zero setup (llamafile-comm-6). However, there is no direct benchmark or claim about actual cold-start latency before first token, and some community feedback highlights slow token generation on modest hardware (llamafile-comm-8) which is a different but related performance concern. Missing for 10: quantified cold-start/time-to-first-token benchmarks, explicit comparison to other runtimes' startup overhead.
